searches.answer: Kubernetes 1.20 will deprecate Docker runtime support, with full removal planned for version 1.22. This change addresses the non-compliance of Docker runtime with the Container Runtime Interface (CRI) for Kubernetes. Kubernetes platforms like Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Red Hat OpenShift have already moved to default container runtimes such as containerd or CRI-O. Users will need to switch to compliant container runtimes like containerd or CRI-O to avoid breaking their clusters.
